title: xAI Releases Automated Calling Feature for Grok Bot Users in the US

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The chatbot developed by Elon Musk now allows its domestic users to delegate voice calls to the AI, though the service is not yet functional for residents of Illinois and Washington. The update enables Grok Bot to place calls to U.S. numbers within supported regions to handle specific tasks, including coordinating with colleagues, canceling subscriptions, or booking services on behalf of the account holder.

The system generates a live text transcript of every interaction and uses a response box to ask the user for details the AI cannot provide during the call. While earlier demonstrations focused on scheduling medical appointments, current users can also use the bot to negotiate phone bills or secure restaurant reservations, provided the person on the other end is notified that the call is being recorded.

selectedTweets.quotedTweetText:
Grok Bot just made a doctor's appointment for me while I was driving...

My daughter hurt her foot landing a jump at dance practice.

I told Grok Bot what happened, how she was feeling, and what I saw: not much swelling, iced, and her pain seemed manageable.

It gave me a few nearby options, including a pediatric orthopedist with X-rays on site, and offered to call when they opened.

Grok Bot called and got her in at 9:30 the same day.

The whole call was transcribed live, and when the receptionist asked for more info, it asked me in real time.

It also got the insurance, payment options and pricing, had the intake forms sent to my email, and put it on my calendar.

The receptionist knew the call was recorded, and I could review the recording afterward.

All while I was driving.

Grok Bot is going to completely change people's lives.
